source: MeetSaathi_Unified_Master_Product_Engineering_v1/design/tokens.json (authoritative) + typography/motion from Complete Product Design Handoff

copy.homeSub: Listen, think and remember—with your permission.
copy.liveEmpty: Listening quietly. Ask whenever you need.
copy.poorInput: Microphone audio is unclear. Some context may be missing.
copy.captureInterrupted: Recording stopped unexpectedly at %s; earlier audio is safe.
copy.notesOnly: Notes-only. I can't hear this conversation; add anything you'd like to remember.
copy.ended: Recording stopped. You can leave—I'll finish preparing your notes.
copy.noEvidence: I can't verify that from the available conversation.
copy.consentLine: Start only when recording and AI assistance are allowed and participants are appropriately informed.
copy.crossSpaceDenied: That memory isn't available in this space.
